scope: Bounded original-scenario native no-driver repeatability diagnosis; no production fix or acceptance waiver.

adjacent_boundary_result.limitation: Separate final-only runs bracket the first difference near the first flush; every earlier step was not individually saved. Original failed runs did not log RNG seed/counter, so their exact historic phases cannot be reconstructed.

limits: Strict original no-driver repeat still fails, including a new untouched original-runner pair. Fixed-seed green controls are diagnostic only.
Both source mechanisms are pinned upstream; Windows process/runtime RNG behavior and long-run repeatability are not measured in this phase.
Other core consumers share rand(); only the first-flush neighborhood is localized. Later residuals are retained without attributing every decimal to a single expression.
Native startup lacks upstream Windows WinMain srand(12345); not patched here, and it cannot by itself prevent later timer reseeding.
Fixed-seed reproducibility and observer neutrality do not rule out uninitialized-state defects in other scenarios or boundaries.
Historical strict AGC resume failure remains open; full flight, graphical-native parity, physical controls and manual landing remain unverified.
